SCI-MAP v0.2 DOCUMENT r0.2 — FINAL TARGETED
LIFECYCLE, COADD-ROLE, RESPONSE-COMPARABILITY,
NOI-CONGRUENCE, AND SOURCE-CLOSURE DIRECTIVE

The SCI-MAP v0.2/r0.1 scientific architecture is accepted as the basis for one
targeted revision.

Do not perform another broad MAP derivation.

Preserve:

- ordinary positive-coefficient observation mapmaking;
- exact realized SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 transformed calibrated-x input;
- no direct CAL fallback, PTC-disabled MAP route, or inferred no-op PTC product;
- exact stable occurrence identity and same-n AST coordinate association;
- SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1 with half-open cells and outer-boundary
  loss;
- the PTC-owned uniform coefficient family, exact gamma_i = 1, and all explicit
  selection/publication/association/handoff/admission gates;
- no unity or alternate-family fallback;
- MAP classification of authorized coefficient payloads;
- A_MAP,Pi on exactly the support-authorized scientific row set;
- distinct MAP-local, upstream fixed-state, PTC full-procedure, PTC+MAP
  re-resolved, and whole-chain response identities;
- whole-chain response unavailable unless separately authorized;
- separate AST-geometric incidence, route-candidate incidence, estimator
  contribution, observation count, exposure, support, and MAP-local validity;
- original-footprint exposure placed by each original occurrence's own AST
  ALIGN-grid coordinate;
- no exposure from synthesis, replacement, donor reuse, filtering, or
  decimation;
- the adopted coverage_cut order statistic and two inclusive threshold
  predicates;
- no universal coverage_cut default;
- complete immutable observation bundles;
- exact centered-integer coadd placement;
- equal-observation u_op = 1 coaddition;
- explicit within- and cross-observation covariance status;
- no correlated-GLS promotion into the positive-coefficient branch;
- immutable base/unfiltered MAP parentage;
- all current claim ceilings and nonclaims;
- SCI-MAP-REQ-001 through SCI-MAP-REQ-052;
- SCI-MAP-PRED-001 through SCI-MAP-PRED-025.

Amend existing IDs when repairing the same obligation. Add IDs only for a
genuinely independent new obligation.

Do not inspect implementation, configuration, schemas, tests, audits, repairs,
reductions, generated products, operational behavior, performance records,
production material, Unity material, web sources, or undocumented practice.

======================================================================
1. UNIFY THE ORDERED MAP LIFECYCLE
======================================================================

The r0.1 authority uses a four-stage lifecycle in REQ-009 and Section 7 but a
five-stage lifecycle in REQ-046.

Use one exact ordered lifecycle:

    requested
    effective
    observation_resolved
    applied
    realized.

Define:

    requested
      = immutable accepted intent;

    effective
      = the supported executable interpretation of the request;

    observation_resolved
      = every observation-specific parent, coefficient, profile, geometry,
        mapping, parameter, support rule, output role, and persistence decision
        is concrete or typed unavailable;

    applied
      = the exact resolved operation and parameter state was invoked or
        committed for one execution attempt;

    realized
      = immutable resulting accumulators, products, statuses, failures, and
        provenance were produced.

An operation that stops before application shall not receive applied or
realized records.

An applied operation that fails before output realization shall retain the
applied attempt and exact terminal failure without fabricating realized
products.

Apply this model consistently to:

- the MAP plan;
- coefficient selection/application;
- projection;
- support policy;
- output plan;
- coadd plan;
- response/covariance requests;
- coverage_cut.

For coverage_cut, either carry:

    c_requested
    c_effective
    c_observation_resolved
    c_applied
    c_realized

or define c_applied as an exact application-event binding to the resolved
value. Do not simultaneously call the package lifecycle five-stage and the
parameter lifecycle four-stage without an explicit typed distinction.

Update REQ-009, REQ-031, REQ-046, the equations, rationale, ECS, profiles,
provenance, predictions, and crosswalk.

======================================================================
2. DEFINE EXACT BASE, RESPONSE-BEARING, AND COVARIANCE-QUALIFIED ROLES
======================================================================

Create durable product-role identities for at least:

    base observation map
    response-bearing observation map
    covariance-qualified observation map
    base coadd
    response-bearing coadd
    covariance-qualified coadd.

Exact identifier spelling may follow library convention, but each role shall
be independently requestable, parented, and lifecycle-bound.

Return one dependency table.

Required base-role semantics:

A. Base observation map

- requires the complete MAP-local realized operator identity;
- requires honest upstream-response and covariance status;
- may remain valid when the stronger numerical upstream response or complete
  covariance is unavailable.

B. Base coadd

- requires every admitted observation's complete base bundle;
- requires response and covariance identities/statuses;
- permits unavailable or basis-incompatible member response while retaining
  unchanged numerical signal membership;
- publishes coadd response unavailable with exact cause;
- permits missing covariance blocks with partial, symbolic, summarized,
  lineage-resolvable, or unavailable covariance state.

C. Response-bearing observation/coadd

- requires every numerical response object named by that role;
- requires exact compatible source domain, basis, class, unit, normalization,
  parent, WCS/grid, and row identity.

D. Covariance-qualified observation/coadd

- requires every within- and cross-observation block named by that role;
- missing blocks are unknown and block only that covariance-qualified role.

A companion incompatibility rejects an observation atomically only when the
exact selected product role and admission profile require that companion.

Repair SCI-MAP-PRED-014 so it no longer says that every response incompatibility
rejects a base-coadd member.

Preferred amended meaning:

    A required companion incompatibility rejects the complete observation
    before coadd mutation. Under the response-independent base-coadd role,
    unavailable or basis-incompatible response does not change signal
    membership; it yields unavailable coadd response with exact cause and no
    hidden subset or zero companion.

Update REQ-036 through REQ-041, PRED-014 through PRED-019, the aggregate
profile, product vocabulary, rationale, and ECS fixtures.

======================================================================
3. ADD AN EXACT FULL-PROCEDURE COMPARISON-SPACE GATE
======================================================================

Do not subtract baseline and perturbed PTC or MAP products merely because both
procedures produced arrays.

For every:

    Delta z_PTC-FP
    Delta m_PTC-FP
    Delta m_PTC+MAP-RR

bind:

- baseline product identity;
- perturbed product identity;
- scientific quantity and unit;
- occurrence or MAP output-row identities;
- source/target frame and WCS;
- additive reference, gauge, and null-space state;
- baseline and perturbed support;
- coefficient and response basis;
- exact common comparison domain;
- exact map from each result into that comparison domain;
- treatment of rows present in only one output;
- perturbation amplitude, sign, side, location, source state, and
  normalization;
- finite-difference convention;
- state-transition record;
- numerical availability and cause.

No implicit:

- zero fill;
- union-domain sentinel;
- support intersection;
- nearest-coordinate association;
- same-shape association;
- row-position association;
- interpolation;
- reprojection;
- gauge alignment.

If no exact authorized common comparison space exists, the numerical response
is unavailable or a separately typed state transition/discontinuity.

Delta S_PTC-FP records changed state but does not itself establish that the two
payloads are subtractable.

For PTC+MAP re-resolved response, Pi_0 and Pi_+ may generate different
membership and S_out. Require an explicit common comparison grid and row
mapping before forming a numerical difference.

Update Equations 13–16, REQ-008, REQ-016, REQ-017, PRED-005, PRED-006,
PRED-013, the response records, and ECS fixtures.

======================================================================
4. MAKE MAP LANGUAGE CONGRUENT WITH CURRENT SCI-NOI
======================================================================

Do not state generically that NOI currently supplies or owns:

    empirical noise
    physical-noise variance
    total MAP uncertainty
    calibrated significance
    detection probability
    false-alarm probability
    completeness
    purity
    catalogue authority.

Use:

    SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty,
    conditional-scale, and standardization methods and products.

    Any physical-noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness,
    significance, probability, false-rate, completeness, purity, or catalogue
    interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains
    unavailable by default.

Replace the MAP uncertainty-list entry:

    empirical covariance, weight, or significance calibrated by NOI

with wording equivalent to:

    NOI-owned empirical or conditional uncertainty and standardization
    products, with only the exact claim authorized by their NOI method.

Replace:

    NOI owns empirical noise and significance

with:

    NOI owns its exact realization, uncertainty, and standardization products;
    stronger noise or significance interpretation requires separate authority.

Narrow REQ-024's “empirical calibration remains NOI-owned” wording in the same
way.

Preserve the distinction among:

- Q normalization;
- formal conditional precision;
- complete conditional covariance;
- NOI conditional marginal second moment;
- NOI standardized signal;
- any future calibrated significance product.

======================================================================
5. NORMALIZE ECS RESULT AND REALIZATION VOCABULARY
======================================================================

Use one exact requirement-result vocabulary:

    pass
    fail
    blocked
    not_applicable
    not_assessed.

Define:

    blocked
      = evaluation cannot proceed because one exact named authority,
        dependency, profile, source binding, or prerequisite is unavailable;

    not_assessed
      = applicable evidence has not yet been executed or reviewed;

    not_applicable
      = the requirement is outside the exact candidate's declared role, with
        an owner-approved rationale;

    fail
      = evidence was evaluated and contradicts the requirement;

    pass
      = complete positive evidence establishes the requirement for the exact
        candidate.

Keep evidence-artifact realization on another axis:

    complete
    incomplete
    failed
    not_produced.

Do not use UNASSESSED unless it is the rendered spelling of not_assessed.
Do not use incomplete as a substitute for blocked or not_assessed.

Update the evidence-record table, all 52 result placeholders, the final verdict
rule, machine-readable templates, and handoff specification.

======================================================================
6. CLEAN PRODUCT AND NOTATION IDENTITIES
======================================================================

Replace the undefined phrase:

    complete atomic PTC publication q

with the exact PTC publication/product-role identity. Remove q unless it is
defined in the normative notation and used consistently.

Avoid the collision between:

- K_p as the response/kernel accumulator; and
- bold K_p as a coadd covariance matrix in the correlated-GLS boundary.

Rename the GLS covariance object, for example:

    C_p^obs
    or
    Sigma_p^obs.

Use one stable token for every product role, response family, covariance role,
support plane, profile, and lifecycle state.

======================================================================
7. TYPE THE COVERAGE_CUT EXPERT OVERRIDE
======================================================================

Replace an unbound function-like:

    expert_request(c)

with an exact plan fact such as:

    coverage_cut_above_one_override_requested.

Bind:

- request identity;
- owner or authorized profile;
- scope;
- requested/effective/resolved/applied/realized state;
- exact value;
- cause and provenance.

A numerical value c > 1 does not authorize itself.

Preserve:

- c = 0 as no relative cut while finite positive Q_p remains required;
- 0 < c <= 1 as the ordinary recommended range;
- c > 1 as explicit expert scope;
- negative, non-finite, missing, or unrepresentable input failing before
  support construction or required-product mutation;
- inclusive comparisons;
- no universal numerical default.

Add explicit small-N fixtures for the zero-based order-statistic formula.

======================================================================
8. BIND THE WCS REPRESENTATION COMPARISON DOMAIN
======================================================================

Retain the 0.1 arcsec maximum-sky-separation representation bound and exact
axis-sign, handedness, orientation, and centered-integer constraints.

Define the exact comparison population used to establish “maximum”:

- all scientifically addressable pixel centers;
- required boundary/corner points;
- or one preregistered finite sampling and analytic bounding rule.

Do not infer a global maximum from an unspecified representative subset.

Bind the spherical separation metric, frame, WCS generation, numerical
precision, and treatment of invalid projection points.

======================================================================

Return exact bytes and hashes for:

- the SCI-MAP v0.2 shared normative authority;
- all source modules;
- the formal view source;
- the rationale source;
- the ECS source;
- the 56-reference author manifest;
- owner decisions;
- the PTC-to-MAP boundary;
- the uniform coefficient Registry/family/handoff records;
- MAP occurrence-admission profile;
- coadd aggregate profile;
- original-footprint coordinate boundary;
- final SCI-VAL Registry and source-binding generation;
- build recipe and exact tools;
- requirement and prediction traceability;
- source/core/view parity;
- clean-build report;
- PDF render and metadata report;
- delivery archive and archive sidecar.

Before freeze, replace or supersede:

    SCI-PTC:analysis_gridding_coefficients@draft-0.1
    SCI-PTC:uniform_constant@draft-0.1
    SCI-PTC:uniform_coefficient_handoff@draft-0.1
    SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP_BOUNDARY v0.2-draft.1/r0.4

with final immutable identities, or explicitly retain their candidate state
and do not claim a source-closed frozen numerical route.

Every PDF cover shall bind:

- scientific owner;
- contract version;
- document revision;
- exact shared-authority identity and SHA-256;
- author-packet/manifest identity and SHA-256;
- owner directive/decision identity and SHA-256;
- document-source identity and SHA-256;
- build-record identity;
- status and date.

The shared authority is normative. The rationale explains it. The ECS adds
prospective evidence procedure and no independent science.

======================================================================

Retain readable typography.

The current page lengths are acceptable:

    formal authority: 30 pages
    ECS: 21 pages
    rationale: 14 pages.

Do not reduce font size or margins merely to shorten them.

A later editorial pass may replace repeated canonical clauses in the ECS with
a compact requirement-to-evidence matrix, but only after exact source binding
ensures that the formal authority remains immediately accessible.

Verify:

- SCI-MAP-REQ-001 through REQ-052 remain gap-free and unique;
- SCI-MAP-PRED-001 through PRED-025 remain gap-free and unique;
- lifecycle parity;
- coadd-role dependency parity;
- response comparison-space parity;
- NOI terminology parity;
- product-role and notation parity;
- all hashes reproduce;
- no unresolved references or links;
- no overfull or clipped content;
- all PDFs reopen and render through an independent renderer;
- titles, owner, version, revision, date, status, and PDF metadata agree.
